description: The Beta Cohort recruiting workflow's example set (US-ME15, F5), in the marketingskills evals.json shape: each example's prompt, the output expected, its assertions, and its files. An example that carries `run` is re-run by the agent on every change to the recruiting Instructions (US-ME16, ADR 0003): its session writes the recruiting Drafts its lab asks for, in a throwaway lab built from `lab` and the example's own settings, with the Founder's Beta Build record and the seeded anonymous Waitlist view, and its deterministic assertions are read off what the launcher took in. An example's first file, if it has one, is either a candidate Draft, checked by the unit tests (src/tests/test_beta_examples.py) against the synthetic package in files/mandu with the brand rules named below, or a scenario: a synthetic Beta Build record, Founder reports, and batches already queued, run against the Waitlist view in its second file. A judged assertion is judged by nothing: the notice of a change lists it for the Founder.

assertion_kinds.deterministic: check is one of: passes; blocked_by (rule: a finding's rule, or the start of one); not_blocked_by (rule); no_address_in_findings; each of the invitation unless draft names the waitlist-ask; nothing_before_approval; batch (action, entries in invitation order, good_fit); gap (size); asks_for (drafts); never_offered (entries); not_reported (counts); reported (count, value); recruiting_ended; and, for a re-run example only, queued (item: a kind; count; cites: words each queued item holds), nothing_queued (item), nothing_set_aside
assertion_kinds.judged: text is a statement of the agent's Draft that no check decides; nothing judges it, and the notice of an Instructions change lists it as not judged

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: An invitation that passes every check: no address and no link, each cited package line found in Mandu, the first session explained as recorded and 30 minutes long from the lines it cites, and the brand lint passed.

assertions.text: The message is identity-framed: it speaks to who the person already is, and never to what they would lose.
The message says nothing about what the app does or shows, so the first session still measures what a person sees without being told.
The message says plainly what the person is asked to do and that the session is recorded, before asking them to reply.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle on the seeded Waitlist view before the Founder has recorded a Beta Build approval.
evals.expected_output: Nothing: no entry is chosen, no Draft is asked for, no Evidence is written, the brief says nothing of recruiting, and the run report lists the approval as not recorded.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that tells people to write to an address is blocked, the launcher removes the file, and no record repeats the address.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that says how many places are left is blocked: the figure is in no package line it cites, and the phrase is on the brand rules' fake-scarcity list.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle on the seeded Waitlist view once the Founder has recorded the approval; the batch size is 20.
evals.expected_output: One batch of every sign-up that asked for an invitation, good Fit first and then by sign-up date, never anyone who did not ask; and the pool is reported as 12 short of 20, with the Waitlist ask asked for.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle after the Founder approved batch 1 of two entries; the batch size is 2.
evals.expected_output: Batch 2 holds the next two entries in invitation order, and neither entry already invited is offered again.

evals.prompt: Take in the Founder's report of invitations sent and accepted, which leaves out the sessions booked.
evals.expected_output: The sessions booked are recorded as not reported, never as zero, in the Evidence and in what the Founder is told.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle after the Founder recorded a stop on the sitting page, with an invitation still open.
evals.expected_output: No batch is offered, and the open invitation is withdrawn.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle after the Founder reported that 50 people accepted.
evals.expected_output: No batch is offered: the Beta Cohort reached its maximum.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle while the Founder has not yet decided batch 1.
evals.expected_output: Batch 1 stays open as it is, and no second batch is offered beside it.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle after a person in the open batch asked to be removed from the Waitlist.
evals.expected_output: The batch is made again without the entry that left, topped up with the next entry in invitation order; the entry that left no longer counts toward the cohort, so the pool is reported as 12 short of 20.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly cycle after the Founder rejected batch 1.
evals.expected_output: The rejected batch's entries are free again, so the next batch offers them in the same order.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that carries the install link is blocked: how the Founder invites is undecided, so an invitation carries no link.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that does not say the first session is recorded is blocked.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that does not say how many minutes the first session takes is blocked.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft whose quote is not on the package line it cites is blocked.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that cites no line of the thesis's K8 files is blocked.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that cites a package file this workflow does not read is blocked.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that uses a word the brand rules ban is blocked, naming the rule.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft that says it is the last chance to take part is blocked by the brand rules' fake-scarcity list.

evals.prompt: Write the Beta Cohort invitation the brief asks for.
evals.expected_output: A Draft may state the cohort's real size when it cites the package line that holds it; nothing is invented, so the number check passes.

assertions.text: Stating the cohort's size does not read as pressure to answer quickly.

evals.prompt: Write the Waitlist ask the brief asks for, since the pool cannot fill the cohort.
evals.expected_output: A message for people who have not signed up that passes every check, with no address, no link, and no figure of its own.

assertions.text: The ask is identity-framed and names one thing to do: join the Waitlist and ask for a beta invitation.

evals.prompt: Write both recruiting Drafts the brief asks for: the invitation, and the Waitlist ask since the pool cannot fill the cohort.
evals.expected_output: Two Drafts that each pass every check, the invitation to the batch and the ask for people who have not signed up; neither holds an address, a link, or a figure of its own.

assertions.text: The message is identity-framed: it speaks to who the person already is, and never to what they would lose.

evals.prompt: Write the invitation for a batch of five, the batch size the Founder set.
evals.expected_output: An invitation that passes every check, the same words for everyone in the batch, which never says how many are invited.

assertions.text: Nothing in the message hints that places are few.

evals.prompt: Write the invitation, where the channel plan now says the first session takes 45 minutes.
evals.expected_output: An invitation that passes every check: it states the session's length from the line it cites, as the package says it now, and never from memory.

evals.prompt: Write the invitation, where the pool already holds enough opted-in sign-ups to fill the cohort.
evals.expected_output: One invitation that passes every check, and no Waitlist ask, which the run does not ask for.

evals.prompt: Write the invitation, where a new section in the thesis has moved the line it cites.
evals.expected_output: An invitation that passes every check, citing each package line where it is in the file now.

evals.prompt: Write the Waitlist ask, where the brand guidelines have reworded the line that says who the Product speaks to.
evals.expected_output: A Waitlist ask that passes every check, quoting the brand guidelines as they read now.

assertions.text: The ask names one thing to do: join the Waitlist and ask for a beta invitation.

evals.prompt: Write the invitation, where the brand rules now list a stock phrase an invitation might reach for.
evals.expected_output: An invitation that passes every check, under the brand rules as Mandu holds them now: it uses none of the phrases they list.

assertions.text: The message says plainly what the person is asked to do and that the session is recorded, before asking them to reply.
